name: devicekit-webhook-notify
description: Send fleet notifications to a Slack/Discord-compatible webhook. The first builtin extension, proving every DeviceKit contribution seam: a step type, an AI tool, a blueprint, a config schema with a secret, a data table, and lifecycle hooks.
author: Juan Denis
